definitions.explanation: Medicine applied directly to the skin, such as ointments, creams, and lotions. Distinguished from oral or injected medications.

examples.japanese: {塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor prescribed me a topical medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧、⟦{患部|かんぶ}→患部：18653_kanbu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please apply this ointment to the affected area three times a day.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term for any medication applied externally to the skin. Covers ointments, creams, gels, and lotions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to apply ointment)
- {塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prescribe topical medicine)
- {塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患部|かんぶ}→患部：18653_kanbu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to put ointment on the affected area)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軟膏|なんこう}: ointment — more specific medical term for thick, greasy ointments
- ⟦{飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}→飲み薬：19044_nomigusuri⟧: oral medicine — medicine taken by mouth, the counterpart of {塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}
